mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waiting_queue (patient_id, sch_id, apply_time, status) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{scheduleRecordId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '排队中')
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.patient_id, w.sch_id, w.apply_time, w.status FROM waiting_queue w WHERE w.patient_id = #{patientId} AND w.sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} ORDER BY w.apply_time ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waiting_queue w WHERE w.patient_id = #{patientId} AND w.sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} AND w.status = '排队中'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waiting_queue w JOIN doc_schedule_record dsr ON w.sch_id = dsr.id WHERE w.patient_id = #{patientId} AND to_char(dsr.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = #{date}

SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM waiting_queue w WHERE w.sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} AND w.status = '排队中' AND w.apply_time < ( SELECT apply_time FROM waiting_queue WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} ORDER BY apply_time LIMIT 1 )
SELECT w.id, w.patient_id, w.sch_id, w.apply_time, w.status FROM waiting_queue w WHERE w.sch_id = #{scheduleRecordId} AND w.status = '排队中' ORDER BY w.apply_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE waiting_queue SET status = '已取消' WHERE id = #{waitingId}
UPDATE waiting_queue SET status = '已成功预约', registration_id = #{registrationId} WHERE id = #{waitingId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_schedule_record WHERE id = #{scheduleRecordId}
SELECT left_source_count FROM doc_schedule_record WHERE id = #{scheduleRecordId}
